message.content:
This editorial illustration is the front cover of TEMPO magazine, dated April 16-22, 2001. At the top, a red banner contains the white text “Inpres Aceh: Solusi atau Bencana”. A dark blue corner banner at the upper right contains yellow text: “Survei Ekonomi” and “Politisasi APBN”. The main masthead “TEMPO” is in large, black serif letters.

The central image features an older man with glasses and balding hair, wearing a grey suit and patterned tie. He is positioned behind a large, maroon pinstriped suit jacket that appears headless. This maroon jacket has its arms crossed, a yellow tie, and a watch on the left wrist. The man in the grey suit reaches one hand forward, placing paper money into the pocket of the maroon jacket.

Bold text overlaid on the jacket reads “Konglomerat Baru, Tipu Daya Salim?” with the first two words in white and the last three in yellow. A barcode and price “Rp 10.000” appear at the bottom. The entire composition uses a painterly, textured style on a white background.
